push.title: W 4-2 vs pijany | You: 8.8 (top 25% FOR)
push.body:
An 8.8 against pijany, PhogsToffees. That's the good stuff, the kind you tell your dog about on the drive home.

DID WELL
+ 3 shots at pijany's goal. The keeper's arms are probably still sore.
+ 4 key passes (up from your usual 2). You saw passes other folks didn't even know existed.
+ A goal against pijany. Goals are like biscuits: always better shared, but I'll take this one.
+ Man of the Match, your 2nd for us. That's leadership you can't fake.
+ BellyTb1 scored and you helped make it happen. Keep feeding those runs.

WORK ON
- 1 of 3 shots on target. Simple fix: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.
- 70% passing (23 of 33). Here's the fix: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
- You and tuxedo_slide were both flagged for forcing passes. Fix it as a pair: give each other short options.

Back-garden drill: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.

You make this job too easy. Don't tell the gaffer. - Coach Lasso

players.name: BellyTb1

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

weaknesses.detail: Pass accuracy: 50% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 71% or less)
weaknesses.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.
Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.
weaknesses.coach: The passing got a little loose out there.

weaknesses.detail: Tackle success: 0% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 18% or less)
weaknesses.title: Tackle timing
tips: Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
weaknesses.coach: Diving in a bit too eager. Patience in the tackle.

push.title: W 4-2 vs pijany | You: 8.7 (top 10% MID)
push.body:
Well, butter my biscuit, BellyTb1. An 8.7. Folks in the top 10% of midfielders don't play much better than that.

DID WELL
+ A hat trick against pijany, your 3rd straight match scoring. The net said thank you, and so do I.
+ 0.7 above your average. Somebody's been doing their homework.
+ 5 shots on target: +0.3. Like finding a twenty in last winter's coat.
+ League-wide, an 8.7 is top 10% territory for a midfielder.
+ Three points off pijany, 4-2. Put 'em in the bank and let 'em earn interest.

WORK ON
- 50% passing (8 of 16, down from your usual 68%). Next match: If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.
- Won 0 of 3 tackles (down from your usual 39%). Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away.
- Passes attempted: 16. Decent, but top-quarter midfielders get to 25+. That's the next rung.
- Tackles attempted: 3. Middle of the pack for a midfielder; the top quarter hits 6+. Room to climb.
- Key passes: 0. Respectable. Top-quarter midfielders get to 2+, and you've got it in you.

Coach's drill: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.

I'm gonna go tell my plant about you. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-2 vs pijany | You: 7.2 (below average MID)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, a 7.2 is a touch under par for a midfielder. That's alright. Even the best tomatoes have a bruise or two.

DID WELL
+ You found BellyTb1 and BellyTb1 found the net. That's chemistry you can't buy at the store.
+ 1 key pass added +0.2 to your rating. Little things add up.
+ We beat pijany 4-2. Wins taste better when everybody chipped in.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted. Tell you what: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.
- 48% passing (10 of 21). Little homework: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
- 0 goals from 3 on target. Coach's secret: Side-foot for accuracy inside the box; power is for outside it.
- PhogsToffees had the same forcing passes trouble. Team up on it: give each other short options.
- Passes attempted: 21. Solid ground. The best midfielders push it to 25+.

Before next match: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.

Growth isn't a straight line. It's more like a squiggle. We're squiggling in the right direction. - Coach Lasso
